facts.business: The company is engaged in the business of trading in plastic granules and other plastic products.

segments.name: Trading in plastic granules and other plastic products

auditor.name: M/s. Shilpi Sharma & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Audit trail (Rule 11(g)): The accounting software used by the Company for maintaining its books of account does not have the feature of recording an audit trail (edit log). Loans granted (CARO paragraph 3(iii)): In respect of loans granted aggregating Rs. 1,236.27 Lakh, the schedule of repayment of principal and payment of interest has not been stipulated. Statutory dues in dispute (CARO paragraph 3(vii)(b)): Demand of Rs. 142.47 Lakh raised under GST Act, 2017 for FY 2019-20, of which Rs. 134.79 Lakh remains unpaid, pending before Commissioner of Customs and Indirect Taxes, Nagpur. Cash losses (CARO paragraph 3(xvii)): The Company incurred cash losses of Rs. 4.43 Lakh in the immediately preceding financial year.

key_risks: Commodity price risk — prices of polymer granules and plastic products linked to crude oil and naphtha prices; limited ability to pass increases to customers due to competition.
Credit risk — principal financial assets are loans of Rs. 1,236.27 Lakh; concentration of balance sheet in this single asset class is a risk.
Liquidity risk — no borrowings but current liabilities of Rs. 108.36 Lakh exceed current assets of Rs. 100.64 Lakh; liquidity depends on ability to call in loans given.
Regulatory risk — GST demand of Rs. 142.47 Lakh for FY 2019-20 under appeal; no provision made.
Business continuity risk — operations as presently constituted do not cover their costs, threatening the existence of the Company.
facts.related_party_note: Members passed special resolutions through postal ballot on 31 July 2025 approving sale of office premises and related party transactions with M/s. Pankaj Infra and Developers for sale of company's share in a residential building. However, shareholders' resolution was not passed for sale of investments in related party companies to related parties where aggregate value exceeds 10% of company's net worth.
